note: A is the pre-2013 version (copy on request, any dwelling); B has the 2013 amendment requiring copies of all appraisals and valuations promptly or 3 business days before consummation, first-lien scope, notice, waiver and E-Sign provisions.

A lacks the later amendments in B on mortgage disclosure carve-outs for N.19(e),(f),(g) and the separate-document requirement for N.20(d), and still has old footnotes and N.19(a)(5)(iii) references.
Differences are only capitalization of Act, regulation versus part, a reserved footnote and the citation line.
A has an extra closing parenthesis and a source citation line; B has a missing parenthesis; the rule is the same.
A lacks the 2017 amendment in B allowing ethnicity and race collection using the HMDA appendix B subcategories and the co-applicant collection option.

A names the Federal Trade Commission as the agency determining greater state-law protection; B names the AGENCY and adds consultation with the GLB Act section 505(a) authority; otherwise the same rule.

B is the old 1996/1997 government benefits text with a 60-day written history alternative; A has the later prepaid account amendments (pre-acquisition disclosures, electronic history, 12 and 24 month history).
